g.text: Waste compatibility screening and segregated containment prevent uncontrolled mixing

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Conservative broad-category screen informed by EPA incompatibility examples. R is not permission to mix; even same-class wastes require specific

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: characterization. Acids/bases are treated as potentially aqueous for W screening. Each illustrated spill path stays in its own containment; no shared

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: drainage or incompatible mixing is drawn. Plan is schematic, with barriers/spacing rather than a dimensioned facility design.
